desc: Viridian Weapon Technologies is devoted to applying cutting-edge technology to design compact, powerful self-defense products for the civilian, military and law enforcement markets. Viridian's new RFX25 series of pistol mounted micro green dots are ready for your favorite pistol, featuring 2 night vision modes, a 3 MOA dot and an battery life of 30,000 hours. Utilizing a 2 minute auto off function and the shield standard footprint, this micro green dot will be able to handle any situation you encounter.
